summary: RPM upgrade system requirements: AAP subscription, RHEL 9.4+ (OpenShift also supported), x86_64/AArch64/s390x/ppc64le, ansible-core 2.16+, Firefox or Chrome, PostgreSQL 15 managed or external 15-17 with ICU (16/17 need external backup).
